name: X.E.H.A. Rogue
source:
Events on the planet Telvoikai and X.E.H.A.'s handling of the situation soured your opinion of the universe-dominating company and led to you going rogue. You've spent the last decade hunting bounties and taking mercenary work in your own name instead. Often these jobs brought you at odds with X.E.H.A., and they seem to have lost their patience. They steal your crew and force you to crash-land on an alien planet where you must start fresh with nothing but a dilapidated base and a... talking cat?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Telvoikai星球上发生的事件和X.E.H.A. 的处理方式让你对这家主宰宇宙的公司的看法恶化，并导致你变得叛逆。在过去的十年里，你一直在寻找赏金，并以自己的名义从事雇佣工作。这些工作常常会让你与X.E.H.A. 发生争执，他们似乎已经失去了耐心。他们偷走了你的船员并迫使你迫降在一个外星星球上，在那里你必须重新开始，除了一个破旧的基地和一只……会说话的猫？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793430/]Steam[/url]]
